$comment: Kit axis values this catalog knowingly does not cover, and why.
An uncovered value is normally work to do. A few are not: Compose publishes no
API that reaches them, or the mapping needs a decision nobody has made yet. Left
undeclared, those sit in the coverage report forever and train the reader to
skim it — the report stops being a list of work and becomes background noise.
Declaring one here takes it out of the report and puts the reason in the diff.
scripts/kit-coverage.mjs checks every entry in BOTH directions: an entry naming
a set, axis or value the kit does not publish fails (the kit moved under us),
and so does an entry for a value the catalog has since covered (the excuse
outlived the problem). So this file cannot quietly rot into a list of things
The State axis is NOT declared here — scripts/interaction-coverage.test.mjs
owns it, with its own NOT_DRAWN_BY_COMPOSE list. One axis, one owner, so the
two can never disagree about the same cell.

declarations.reason: The year grid is internal DatePicker state with no parameter that opens it.
declarations.evidence: androidx.compose.material3.DisplayMode publishes Picker and Input only; DatePickerKt exposes no year-mode argument.

declarations.reason: Compose publishes no docked toolbar — only the floating pair the catalog already renders.
declarations.evidence: material3 exports HorizontalFloatingToolbar and VerticalFloatingToolbar; no Docked* toolbar composable exists.

declarations.reason: ListItem exposes content slots only; segmented containers and expandable, drag, or swipe behaviours are caller composition. Reproducing these kit types would require hand-building the surrounding list interaction rather than invoking another Material 3 component.
declarations.evidence: ListItem has a single overload with no type parameter; expand, drag and swipe are caller-supplied behaviour.

declarations.reason: Compose publishes no hero or multi-aspect-ratio carousel composable; its centered hero and multi-browse APIs are different kit values.
declarations.evidence: androidx.compose.material3.carousel exports HorizontalCenteredHeroCarousel, HorizontalMultiBrowseCarousel and HorizontalUncontainedCarousel only.

declarations.reason: This is a kit-only taxonomy value, not a SuggestionChip implementation requirement. Compose models SuggestionChip as an action with no selection state; using the selectable FilterChip would misname the API, while an ordinary SuggestionChip cannot depict these cells.
declarations.evidence: The AndroidX Material 3 Chip.kt source delegates SuggestionChip and ElevatedSuggestionChip to non-selectable Chip with enabled and icon inputs; FilterChip separately takes selected and delegates to SelectableChip: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/support/+/c62c2b9bba83ccfeeb96c0912cc86151b348e5ff/compose/material3/material3/src/commonMain/kotlin/androidx/compose/material3/Chip.kt

declarations.reason: Blocked on a decision, not an API: whether ModalWideNavigationRail is what the kit means by Floating is a judgement call, and guessing it would point a parity diff at the wrong node.
declarations.evidence: ModalWideNavigationRail exists and may be the right mapping; nothing in the kit or the API confirms it.
